                local sn = 0
                for i=1, #tokens do
                    sn = sn * 67 + tokens[i] + 1
                end
                local high_bits = 1234
                local low_bits = sn & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFF
                local result = (high_bits << 48 & 0xFFFF000000000000) | low_bits
                return result
            end
